games.$comment: Converted here from doom1-shareware.wad with this project's whd_gen, so it carries the deterministic Huffman ordering; upstream's committed .whd predates that fix and differs. The name is the one the variant table gives this dump, so a user converting the same WAD overwrites it instead of getting a second copy.

description.en: Knee-Deep in the Dead, the freely redistributable first episode, converted and published with this release. Installs ready to play, so the core does something useful before the user supplies a WAD of their own. The other episodes and Doom II need WADs you own, converted with the tool above.
An IWAD from a Doom game you own. Each WAD is converted separately into its own game on the card.
description.fr: Un IWAD d'un jeu Doom que vous possédez. Chaque WAD est converti séparément en son propre jeu sur la carte.
description.de: Eine IWAD aus einem Doom-Spiel, das Ihnen gehört. Jede WAD wird einzeln in ein eigenes Spiel auf der Karte umgewandelt.

$comment: uses[].required is false because the shareware episode ships with the release: the install works, and plays, without converting anything. The converter is for the WADs a user owns, and its own input stays required -- it cannot run without a file.
